prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted performance, while zero or negative forecasts repeatedly preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.0% and -9.1%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) yielded 2 clear winning tests (+7.6% and +5.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both significant wins (+2.5% to +6.7%) and severe losses (-4.5% to -9.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both tests, and categories with fewer than 2 agreeing tests remain thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split View Layout: Redesign the story screen to use a split layout with narrative text on one side and companion visual previews on the other. (why: Earlier onboarding tests showed story screen redesigns yielded consistent wins (+7.6% and +5.7%), helping engage users before path selection.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Spotlight Focus Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout that emphasizes account protection and pet backup benefits. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again; sign_in has an 11.9% drop-off.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Showcase Layout: Redesign the companion selection screen into a two-column layout comparing pet attributes and visuals side by side. (why: Adoption has the second lowest step conversion at 78.8% with a long median duration of 89s, indicating decision friction.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Trait Builder Screen: Add a dedicated personality trait customization screen between companion pick and photo upload steps. (why: Users take median 89s on adoption; adding a structured trait choice step enhances emotional connection and guides users to completion.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Notification Opt-In: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and generation progress details on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting stage takes a median 201s and mean 2336s, causing significant drop-off while pet generation occurs in background.)
5: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Docking Hint: Add explicit instructions on the home intro screen detailing how to access pet controls from the system tray. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet after onboarding, while finish stage conversion drops to 68.0%.)
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Sync Protection Hint: Display a confirmation hint on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users that pet progress is saved. (why: Addressing account sync concerns (8 support emails) before finishing adoption builds trust and prevents drop-off before generation.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Device Sync Assurance Hint: Add a hint to the sign-in screen confirming that account login preserves and syncs pet data. (why: 8 support emails were reported regarding reset or missing pets upon re-authenticating.)
8: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Spotlight Dock Layout: Update the waiting screen layout to a spotlight format centering pet generation status. (why: Waiting stage suffers high mean duration (2336s); a spotlight presentation clarifies active pet processing status.)
9: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Welcome Layout: Update the home intro screen layout to a split view displaying launch action alongside desktop control highlights. (why: Finish conversion drops to 68.0% (mean 5815s); a split layout presents launch steps clearly without adding additional screen overhead.)
